methods.steps: Open the PES with File > Open. Press Shift+Ctrl+E to open Export PNG Image, choose the export area, set the size in pixels, enter a file name and click Export.
methods.limits: The PES opens in Manual Stitch Mode; the PNG is a picture of the stitches.

methods.steps: Run pyembroidery.write_png(pyembroidery.read_pes('design.pes'), 'design.png').
methods.limits: PNG is write-only in the library.

methods.steps: Open the PES with File > Open (Manual Stitch Mode), then save the document, choosing Inkscape SVG or Plain SVG as the format.
methods.limits: The SVG is a drawing of the stitches.

methods.steps: Run pyembroidery.write_svg(pyembroidery.read_pes('design.pes'), 'design.svg').
methods.limits: SVG is write-only in the library.

methods.steps: Open the PNG, choose File > Export As, name the file with .xbm and set the XBM options.
methods.limits: Works only from an image with 8 bits per channel; black and white only.

methods.steps: Run magick picture.png picture.xbm.
methods.limits: XBM is read and written for black and white only.

methods.steps: Run magick picture.png -background white -alpha remove -alpha off -monochrome picture.xbm.
methods.limits: -alpha remove composites over the background color; -monochrome transforms the image to black and white.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i archive.ra -vn -b:a 192k -c:a libmp3lame listening.mp3.
methods.limits: Requires a decoder for the actual RealAudio variant.

methods.steps: Click Add and choose the RA file, set the Output Format field to mp3, then click Convert.
methods.limits: RA is a source format in Switch; mp3 is an output format.

methods.steps: Run magick -density 144 artwork.svg artwork.tga.
methods.limits: -density sets the canvas resolution while SVG is rendered; SVG and TGA are both read and written.

methods.steps: Open the SVG in Inkscape, press Shift+Ctrl+E, choose the export area, enter the width in pixels, name the file and click Export, then run magick artwork.png artwork.tga.
methods.limits: Inkscape exports PNG; ImageMagick reads PNG and writes TGA.

methods.steps: Run magick -density 180 illustration.svg illustration.tif.
methods.limits: -density sets the canvas resolution while SVG is read; SVG and TIFF are both read and written.

methods.steps: Open the SVG in Inkscape, press Shift+Ctrl+E, choose the export area, enter the width in pixels, name the file and click Export, then run magick illustration.png illustration.tif.
methods.limits: Inkscape exports PNG; ImageMagick reads PNG and writes TIFF.

methods.steps: Use Add to pick the WAV, enter amr in the Output Format field and press Convert.
methods.limits: wav is a source format in Switch and amr is an output format.

methods.steps: Run cwebp -lossless -exact still.webp -o recoded.webp.
methods.limits: WebP input is accepted for static images only; -exact keeps RGB values in transparent areas.

methods.steps: Open the WebP with File > Open, choose File > Export As, enter a new name ending in .webp and click Export, then set the WebP options.
methods.limits: The dialog has Lossless, Image quality, Alpha quality and Save animation settings.

methods.steps: Run magick still.webp -define webp:lossless=true rewritten.webp.
methods.limits: The webp:lossless define encodes without any quality loss; WEBP is read and written.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i take.wma -vn -c:a pcm_s16be take.aiff.
methods.limits: Needs a decoder for the WMA variant; writes 16-bit big-endian PCM.

methods.steps: Click Add and choose the WMA; open the Output Format field and select AIFF; click Convert.
methods.limits: Output uses Switch encoder defaults.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i footage.wmv -map 0 -c copy wrapped.mkv.
methods.limits: Keeps the existing streams without re-encoding.

methods.steps: Click Add File(s) and pick the WMV; select MKV in the Output Format field; click Convert.
methods.limits: Re-encodes through Prism; the receiving player must decode the codecs.

pes.fact: PES is supported embroidery data; imported patterns use manual stitch mode rather than original digitizing objects.

png.fact: PNG supports lossless raster storage with several color modes and alpha.

svg.fact: SVG can describe vectors and embedded pictures, with coordinate transformations and font dependencies.

xbm.fact: XBM is monochrome C-style bitmap text; GIMP documents hotspots and separate masks.

ra.fact: RealAudio includes several codecs; RAM streaming references are distinct from the recorded media.

mp3.fact: MP3 is lossy; re-encoding cannot restore earlier removed information.

tga.fact: Targa is raster;24bitRGB and32bitwithalpha are separate choices.

tif.fact: TIF aliases TIFF; its compression can be lossless or lossy and depth varies.

wav.fact: WAVE is RIFF-based and may contain PCM or other coding.

amr.fact: Narrowband AMR samples speech at8kHz; AMR-WB is separate.

webp.fact: WebP uses RIFF-based packaging, offers lossy/lossless and alpha, and can be animated.

wma.fact: WMA is ASF-based; standard,Pro,Lossless andVoice variants differ.

aiff.fact: AIFF commonly contains PCM; uncompressed sample-format choices determine precision.

wmv.fact: WMV content is normally ASF-packaged; Windows Media video has several variants.

mkv.fact: Matroska can organize multiple media tracks; the container does not specify fidelity.

sharedSheets.pilotBackground: Read format-guides.json for existingPNG/SVG/WebP/MP3 background. TIF resolves to TIFF inF02.
